definition.description: Establish a comfortable bodyweight deep-squat base with supported feet. Elbows may contact the inner knees. Apply gentle outward pry pressure or a small deliberate side-to-side weight shift while breathing, then return or exit under control. This excludes a squat-to-stand sequence, Cossack, lateral lunge, loaded squat, static test, forced hold, and unassigned reach.

environment.space: room to enter and exit the assigned squat base
environment.changeRule: Changing stance, depth, support, reach, shift, duration, tempo, load, surface, dose, or intent requires revalidation.

selectionPrerequisites: can enter and exit the assigned squat base
clear stable surface and exit path
can use a small comfortable range without symptom escalation
understands the stop signal and session logistics fit
excludeOrEscalate: symptom, restriction, unsafe base, surface, support, or communication conflict
sharp, increasing, unfamiliar, neurologic, circulation, breathing, chest, balance, or communication concern
notEstablishedByEvidence: universal stance, foot angle, depth, support, dose, recovery, outcome, readiness threshold, or clinical clearance

provenance.identityAuthority: Source 61 reassessed with migration-390 reach duplicate traceability and explicit squat-to-stand, Cossack, and lateral-lunge boundaries.

anatomy.laterality: bilateral foot-supported base; record intentional side shift separately
anatomy.claimsBoundary: Task mechanics only; no diagnosis, treatment, flexibility, injury-prevention, or performance claim.

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Candidate low-load squat-access work only when the exact base, range, support, and dose fit.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Set a comfortable squat, gently pry or shift, breathe, and own the exit before you force depth.
secondaryCues: use elbows only for gentle pressure
make the range or duration smaller before forcing depth
stop before pinching, dizziness, or passive sinking
expectedSensations: light trunk and optional elbow support effort
unexpectedSensations: pain, numbness, tingling, dizziness, loss of foot contact, or a position that cannot be exited safely
selfChecks: pry or shift is gentle and deliberate

observationChecklist: exact squat base, stance, range, support, and reach assignment
duration, breath, symptoms, and first quality loss

faultCorrections.forced_depth_or_width: reduce range or duration, use support, or stop
faultCorrections.foot_or_trunk_collapse: reduce depth and restore an owned base
faultCorrections.unable_to_exit: use a simpler reviewed task after revalidation

doNotUseWhen: the floor, support, exit route, or communication is unsafe
the task conflicts with symptoms or restrictions
the intended task is a hinge/stand/reach sequence, Cossack, lateral lunge, loaded squat, assessment, or forced range

supportOperations.supportEscalation: Stop unresolved safety, symptom, base, support, or quality issues.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any task change reruns selection, logistics, duration, fatigue, substitutions, and validation.

sourceVariant.displayName: Deep Squat Pry Legacy Skeleton — Source 61
sourceVariant.archiveReason: The source lacks exact exposure/exit, stance/depth/support, fatigue, delivery, alternate, calibration, and review contracts.

snapshot.description: Hold deep squat and pry knees open.

requirements.cycleRule: one assigned controlled pry/shift exposure followed by an owned reset or exit is one exposure
requirements.rangeRule: comfortable squat range without forced depth, passive sinking, lost foot contact, or trunk compensation

dosage.countRule: count only exposure completed at the assigned base with controlled breath, foot contact, and exit

deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: The assigned squat base, foot contact, trunk, breath, and controlled exit remain organised; the pry or shift is gentle; range is comfortable; and no stop symptom appears.
stopRules: stop on pain, new symptoms, dizziness, unsafe support, or participant request
stop when foot contact, breath, exit, range, or trunk control cannot be restored
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Assign stance, range, support, and duration; observe feet, knees, trunk, breath, and exit; reduce range or duration before adding volume; revalidate any alternate.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Set the assigned squat, breathe, gently pry or shift, reset or exit under control, and stop before you force range or lose foot contact.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate preparation only; no outcome is guaranteed.

doseScaling.reduce: shallower range, shorter duration, fewer cycles, stable support, more rest, or another reviewed task
doseScaling.doNotAutoProgress: Do not force depth or knee width, add load, turn the task into a squat-to-stand/reach, or substitute a lateral task without revalidation.

supportPrompts.athlete: Comfortable squat, gentle pry, easy breath, owned exit.
supportPrompts.coach: Difficulty describes the task—not an athlete-skill label.

legacy.description: Archived Source 61 remains traceable as an underspecified deep-squat-pry skeleton.
legacy.loadNote: Candidate-only; use the exact squat base and record stance, range, support, breath, compensation, and symptoms.
legacy.cardSummary: Source 61 is represented by an exact candidate contract rather than its vague legacy row.
legacy.coachLanguage: Use an exact candidate only after base, range, support, duration, fatigue, and downstream-demand checks.
legacy.athleteLanguage: Comfortable squat; gently pry, breathe, and exit with control.

coachingExecution.quality_gate: Legacy source is not selectable; use exact candidate contract.

safety.prerequisiteNotes: Readiness is the exact base, stance, range, support, controlled pry/shift, exit, symptoms, communication, dose, and downstream task—not a participant classification.
readinessChecks: confirm assigned floor, stance, support, and exit route
confirm a small controlled squat-pry exposure and exit
confirm stop signal and clear path
stopSigns: dizziness, chest, neurologic, circulation, balance, or support symptoms
unsafe surface, forced range, inability to exit, or persistent quality loss
contraindications: squat-to-stand/reach, Cossack, lateral-lunge, loaded-squat, assessment, or forced-range intent
commonSubstitutions: Use another reviewed task only after revalidation.
Do not treat Squat-to-Stand with Reach, Cossack, lateral lunge, loaded squat, or assessment as automatic substitutions.

score.reviewNotes: Candidate task-only reassessment; independent calibration required.
